r.지역: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan
r.정부 수반: Salman bin Hamad, Crown Prince of Bahrain
r.문화권·종교: Arabic · Islam, mostly Shia, Sunni royal family
r.경제 체제: From oil to finance and aluminum
r.주식시장 시가총액: $21.3 billion, 44% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $4.77 for a Big Mac, $1.45 less than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist)
r.생활 물가 수준: 49% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Wire, cable 18%, Cars 16%, Refined petroleum 16%, Other oil, fuels, gas, coal 14% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Refined petroleum 64%, Aluminum 18%, Iron ore 8%, Organic chemicals 3% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A Sunni royal family rules a population that is mostly Shia.

t.why: It hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet and established ties with Israel in 2020.
t.rel: An island country linked to Saudi Arabia by a causeway, under strong Saudi influence. It hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet and established ties with Israel in 2020.
t.know: It was the first Middle Eastern country to host a Formula One race.
t.etext: Its oil started running down earlier than other Gulf states', so it expanded into finance, aluminum and tourism. It is one of the centers of Islamic finance.
